correctness.rationale: Each idempotent with binary diagonal d is U=1+J-conjugate to its diagonal via u=Ed+(1-E)(1-d); stabilizer coordinates imply exactly q^{c(d)} idempotents with that diagonal. Elementary cover transvections make crossing-cover entries independently uniform, leaving q^{c(d)-s(d)} residual fibers. Longstaff–Rosenthal Main Theorem (read in full primary text) says generation is equivalent to pairwise diagonal separation and, for every cover, a linear combination of generators with equal endpoint diagonal entries and nonzero cover entry. For diagonal-difference vector delta with h nonzero coordinates, exactly the q vectors on line F_q delta violate the condition, yielding factor q^h-q; all noncovers contribute q^h as counted fibers. Includes char2, k0 and antichains. Own exhaustive GF2 upper-triangular incidence algebra computations yielded 8 (2-chain,k=2), 0 (3-chain,k=2), 1920 (3-chain,k=3), matching the formula on all 36,676,17576 candidate tuples respectively. Infinite all-poset result depends on structural orbit/criterion proof, not finite enumeration.
